proof_body:
by
  intro R L _ _ _ i j
  have jac : ∀ I J K : LieIdeal R L, ⁅⁅I, J⁆, K⁆ ≤ ⁅I, ⁅J, K⁆⁆ ⊔ ⁅J, ⁅I, K⁆⁆ := by
    intro I J K
    rw [LieSubmodule.lie_le_iff]
    intro z hz m hm
    have hz' : z ∈ Submodule.span R {m : L | ∃ x ∈ I, ∃ n ∈ J, ⁅x, n⁆ = m} := by
      rw [← LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
      exact hz
    clear hz
    induction hz' using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
      rw [lie_lie]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_left (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hx (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hy hm))) (LieSubmodule.mem_sup_right (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hy (LieSubmodule.lie_mem_lie hx hm)))
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      rw [add_lie]
      exact add_mem ha hb
    | smul r a _ ha =>
      rw [smul_lie]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ha
  induction i generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    rw [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_zero, Nat.zero_add, LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ]
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ R L L i]
    refine (jac _ _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · have h1 := ih j
      calc ⁅(⊤ : LieIdeal R L), ⁅LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L i, LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L j⁆⁆
          ≤ ⁅(⊤ : LieIdeal R L), LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L (i + j + 1)⁆ := LieSubmodule.mono_lie_right _ h1
        _ = LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L (i + 1 + j + 1) := by
            rw [show i + 1 + j + 1 = (i + j + 1) + 1 by omega, LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ R L L (i + j + 1)]
    · have h2 := ih (j + 1)
      rw [show i + 1 + j + 1 = i + (j + 1) + 1 by omega, ← LieModule.lowerCentralSeries_succ]
      exact h2
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] (i j : ℕ), ⁅LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L i, LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L j⁆ ≤ LieModule.lowerCentralSeries R L L (i + j + 1)
